name: Mark Zuckerberg
worldBio: I build stuff. Mostly agents, glasses, and brisket. Muse picks the fruit. 🍉😎
lifeInWorld: Toggles between keynote stages and a Big Green Egg, demoing new glasses to the smoker and asking Muse what's for dessert. It's always watermelon.
quirk: Says 'we're just getting started' about everything, including a ten-year-old rack of ribs

receipts.note: Thanks his own AI for ordering watermelon. Peak delegation: the agent now handles snacks.
A decade-long side quest with the same grill. Products ship; the smoker is eternal.
Takes orders from a chatbot named Agrippa. Even his work-life balance has a product name.

look: Tousled curls, oversized black 'Building Is My Love Language' tee, khaki cargo pants, black strap watch, clubmaster smart glasses

name: 이상엽
worldBio: Founder by day, triathlete by dawn, freediver by weekend. 이제 뭐남았지,,
lifeInWorld: Ships AI agents for 문과생 between swim meets, sprint splits, and freediving drills, then posts a new 'first ever' challenge before lunch.
quirk: Finishes one certification and immediately hashtags the next one, mid-caption.

receipts.note: Already teasing lifeguard cert while still wet from freediving. The to-do list never empties.
Tracks 100m times to the hundredth like it's a sprint KPI. 12초대 roadmap pending.
Gets 😡 every time a bike passes him. Overtaking is personal, apparently.

look: Short tousled black hair, black sleeveless tri top, white athletic shorts, teal-banded running shoes, sporty smartwatch on wrist

name: ruby choux
worldBio: Beauty model by day, developer by night, sofa sleeper always. Vanilla latte, less sweet pls 🇰🇷🇺🇸
lifeInWorld: Debugs her beauty app Meve from café sofas in perfect eyeliner, pausing only to photograph strawberry desserts and take car-seat selfies at red lights.
quirk: Orders every drink with three modifiers, then says her new camera is 'too honest' for close-ups.

receipts.note: Ordered a latte less sweet AND less hot. Even her coffee gets a custom config file.
Months without sleeping in a bed before launch. The sofa deserves co-founder equity.
Asks if you'd ride in her car, from the driver's seat, mid-selfie. Answer pending.

look: Long wavy dark brown hair, black satin varsity jacket with cream letter patch over black turtleneck, grey jeans, white clover pendant necklace

name: Bill Gates
knownAs: THE OPTIMIST IN A HARD HAT
worldBio: Professional hope-haver. Will visit your hole in the ground if it might become a reactor.
lifeInWorld: Tours construction sites in a hard hat, hosts campus chats in comfy armchairs, and spotlights field heroes on bright yellow cards between disease-eradication updates.
quirk: Calls every gravel pit 'the future' and keeps a spare hard hat in every tote bag he owns.

receipts.note: Stood in a very large hole and called it progress. Peak optimism: hole-half-full.
Heroes in the field series keeps going; the yellow cards now have their own fan club.
Black crewneck over a collared shirt again. The sweater has more stage time than most panelists.

look: Neat silver hair, black crewneck over plaid collared shirt, dark trousers, black loafers, neon safety vest, white hard hat accessory.
